verdict.rationale: dlt does not publish a true OpenAPI/Swagger spec — explicit probing of standard OpenAPI endpoints returned 404s (dlt-probe-3). However, it exposes a machine-readable equivalent: an MCP server-card.json manifest describing its tools/capabilities (dlt-docs-47, dlt-docs-72) plus an llms.txt machine-readable docs feed (dlt-probe-1, dlt-probe-2), which partially satisfies the 'machine-readable spec' need for AI agents. Missing for 10: an actual OpenAPI/Swagger document, and independent confirmation that the MCP manifest is treated as a full substitute by AI-native consumers.
